content.short: Crypto payments pioneer now building tokenized stock baskets anyone can issue in seconds.
content.description: Pundi X made its name with XPOS terminals that let shops accept crypto at the till. Its next product, Stock Basket, lets anyone turn an investment idea into a tradeable basket of tokenized equities, backed 1:1 by real stocks and priced live, in seconds rather than the months an ETF takes. Baskets are self-custodied, trade around the clock and can be shared with a link.
content.meta: Pundi X, known for crypto point-of-sale, is launching Stock Baskets: tokenized equity portfolios issued in seconds.
